name: Kon Margarin
source:
A miner and the fiance of [url=/c96891]Kana Seihajuu Oosaka[/url]. 

[spoiler]He became trapped in the Rekka Mines during Helman's occupation of Leazas, but was rescued by a reluctant Rance. He is a friendly but seemingly oblivious young man that is completely unaware of the fact that his fiance is in a lesbian relationship with [url=/c36801]Milli Yorks[/url] behind his back. He is grateful to Rance for saving his life, and offers to invite him to his and Kana's wedding, despite Rance's repeated attempts at killing him and taking Kana for himself.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kon_Margarin]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
